newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate drops to 10.8 vs 11.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate drops to 10.8 vs 11.9 pct.

text.p: Croatian average lending rate dropped 1.1 percentage points to 10.8 percent on Thursday despite strong demand.
The daily trade was put at 51.8 million kuna against a supply of 58 million.
Fresh borrowings accounted for 45.7 million kuna, most of them call money deals granted at a steady 10.5 percent.
Insurers rolled over one-week funds at between nine and 14 percent.
Banks charged 15 percent for renewed one-month and two-week deals.
The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Friday weaker at 6.1724 against the dollar and firmer at 3.5729 against the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom 385-1-4557075
